lines.lyric_translation: Across the mountain across the mountain
Across the river across the river

lines.lyric: Saneul neomeo sanmaek gangeul neomeo bada
lines.lyric_hangul: 산을 넘어 산맥 강을 넘어 바다
lines.lyric_translation: Across the mountain and range across the river and the ocean
Across all of it and the next
It’s not hard, in this rough jungle
It was me who ran into it, I’m okay

lines.lyric: We goin’ higher daeum doshi soge
lines.lyric_hangul: We goin' higher 다음 도시 속에
lines.lyric_translation: We goin’ higher in the next city
Looking down the buildings, fly all day

lines.lyric_hangul: 워어오 워어오 워오 Higher 저 위로 갈래
lines.lyric_translation: Woah-oh-oh woah-oh-oh woah-oh higher I’m going up over there

lines.lyric_translation: Woah-oh-oh woah-oh-oh woah-oh higher I’m going to fly higher

There’s no way because it’s my first time
I was daring because it’s my first time
That it was my first time became a weapon
It’s my first time, my first time, all of them

lines.lyric: Dok, deot, dokbeoseot eodi hanbeon kkara bwara
lines.lyric_hangul: 독, 덫, 독버섯 어디 한번 깔아 봐라
lines.lyric_translation: Poison, trap, toadstool you can set them up
I’ll survive in the end, whatever it takes

lines.lyric: Naneun ara hamjeong ttawi kkara bwatja nan deo ssege balba
lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 알아 함정 따위 깔아 봤자 난 더 세게 밟아
lines.lyric_translation: I know your traps, you set them up and I stomp on them tougher

lines.lyric: Dabeun hana mwodeun kkago bomyeon dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 답은 하나 뭐든 까고 보면 돼
lines.lyric_translation: There’s only one answer, you just have to open it
It’s not hard, in this rough jungle

lines.lyric: Run through the miro like a beast
lines.lyric_hangul: Run through the 미로 Like a beast
lines.lyric_translation: Run through the maze like a beast
I’m avoiding all the familiar paths
Though inexperienced, it’s a new challenge

lines.lyric_translation: Imma Bear Grylls anything that blocks my dream / I’m going to eat it up

parts.lyric: Imma Bear Grylls nae kkumeul makneun geotdeureun
